svg.title: Sunset Lookout Utila: circular summit plate, infinity mirror water and hammock posts
svg.desc: Concept amenities over the measured terrace plan and actual centreline terrain. Shallow mirror water occupies the downhill segment; three hammocks connect four conceptual six metre posts on the dry terrace. Posts are projected into the section, not measured centreline supports. No structure or safe access is approved.

g.text: Infinity water. A suspended sunset web.
The same 18 m plate on the same hillside, now with an illustrative water-and-hammock layout. Base 0 m remains the lower path arrival.
18 m plate / 254.5 m² total level surface
Dark front arc = infinity overflow edge
Four brown dots = conceptual posts; H1–H3 = hammock nets
Plate and water remain inside the recorded boundary in plan.
Ground descent: 9.20 m across 18 m horizontally
Same terrain centreline; post/hammock silhouettes are off-axis projections.
6 m post height is only a scale test, not a selected specification.
Elevated hammock access, guards, anchors and wind response are undesigned.
Overflow recirculates; catch trough / plant not sized
Structure below the plate is NOT designed
Front surface-to-ground gap remains about 8.35 m
Distance downhill; equal horizontal / vertical scale
Water-only estimate at 0.20 m depth: 16.7 m³ / roughly 16.7 tonnes, before basin, people or other loads.
Hammocks sit on the dry portion in this first overlay. A later outward-reaching sunset web needs a separate clearance and rights study.
Concept only: no foundations, pool basin, posts/anchors, fall protection, raised-perch access or structural capacities have been selected.
Existing bedroom positions are paused. Upper access must be re-planned; the former route is not presented as a usable connection to this plate.
